title: The Britpop Music Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-4-5 for "britpop". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which Britpop band released the 1994 album 'Definitely Maybe'?
questions.answerNote: It became the fastest-selling debut album in UK history at the time.

questions.prompt: What was Blur's only UK number one single during the Britpop era?
questions.answerNote: It beat Oasis's 'Roll With It' to number one in the famous Battle of Britpop chart showdown in 1995.

questions.prompt: Which of these Pulp songs reached number two in the UK charts in 1995?
questions.answerNote: Despite being one of the defining Britpop anthems, it was kept off the top spot by a charity single.

questions.prompt: Elastica's lead singer Justine Frischmann previously dated which Britpop frontman?
questions.answerNote: She left Suede, where she'd been with Brett Anderson, and later formed Elastica while with Damon.

questions.prompt: Which Oasis album featured the track 'Champagne Supernova'?
questions.answerNote: The seven-and-a-half-minute track closed the 1995 album and featured Paul Weller on guitar.

questions.prompt: Which of these bands did NOT play at the famous Knebworth concerts in 1996?
questions.answerNote: Oasis headlined two nights with over 250,000 people attending across the August weekend.

questions.prompt: Suede's debut single 'The Drowners' reached which UK chart position in 1992?
questions.answerNote: Despite the modest chart position, the single helped launch Britpop and got Suede on the cover of Melody Maker.

questions.prompt: What was the title of Sleeper's highest-charting UK single in 1995?
questions.answerNote: The track about social awkwardness peaked at number 16 and became their signature song.

questions.prompt: Which album gave Ocean Colour Scene their UK number one in 1996?
questions.answerNote: The album was championed by Noel Gallagher and featured the hit 'The Day We Caught the Train'.

questions.prompt: Brett Anderson and Bernard Butler left which band to form Suede?
questions.answerNote: They formed Suede from scratch in 1989, though Butler later left Suede in 1994 during a recording session.
